# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: Text (spec 6.2/6.3). Producing text is display vocabulary;
# the predicates and length stay wire-legal.

== a text literal
expr "hello"
want Text "hello"

== length is a method
env note: Text = "ready"
expr note.Length()
want Num 5

== length is wire-legal
tier wire
env note: Text = "ready"
expr note.Length()
want Num 5

== upper
expr "Mixed Case".Upper()
want Text "MIXED CASE"

== lower
expr "Mixed Case".Lower()
want Text "mixed case"

== title
expr "the jog head".Title()
want Text "The Jog Head"

== trim
expr "  padded  ".Trim()
want Text "padded"

== slice
expr "abcdef".Slice(1, 4)
want Text "bcd"

== slice with negative indexes counts from the end
expr "abcdef".Slice(-3, -1)
want Text "de"

== slice collapsed range is empty
expr "abcdef".Slice(4, 2)
want Text ""

== startsWith
expr "gauge_1".StartsWith("gauge")
want Bool true

== endsWith
expr "gauge_1".EndsWith("_1")
want Bool true

== contains
expr "the jog head".Contains("jog")
want Bool true

== contains misses
expr "the jog head".Contains("axis")
want Bool false

== predicates are wire-legal
tier wire
env note: Text = "E42 overtravel"
expr note.StartsWith("E42")
want Bool true

== replace
expr "a-b-c".Replace("-", "+")
want Text "a+b+c"

== padStart
expr "7".PadStart(3, "0")
want Text "007"

== split and join
expr "a,b,c".Split(",").Join("|")
want Text "a|b|c"

== split counts pieces
expr "a,b,c".Split(",").Length()
want Num 3

== concatenation joins text
expr "jog " + "head"
want Text "jog head"

== concatenation renders a number the way str does
expr "n=" + 5
want Text "n=5"

== concatenation renders a bool
expr "is " + true
want Text "is true"

== toFixed
expr (3.14159).ToFixed(2)
want Text "3.14"

== str of a number
expr Str(12.5)
want Text "12.5"

== str of text passes through
expr Str("x")
want Text "x"

== num parses text
expr Num("12.5")
want Num 12.5

== num of unparseable text is unknown
expr Num("reading")
want nil

== int truncates toward zero
expr Int(3.9)
want Num 3

== int truncates negative toward zero
expr Int(-3.9)
want Num -3

== int of a bool
expr Int(true)
want Num 1

== int parses text
expr Int("42.7")
want Num 42

== concatenation is display vocabulary
tier wire
env note: Text = "x"
expr note + "y"
error display vocabulary

== upper is display vocabulary
tier wire
env note: Text = "x"
expr note.Upper()
error display vocabulary

== toFixed is display vocabulary
tier wire
expr (1.5).ToFixed(1)
error display vocabulary
